title: Architecture dependency and semantic-owner enforcement
purpose: Enforce the live package dependency DAG, public entries and dependency direction.
Fail closed on cycles, deep imports, dependency inversions and duplicate semantic owners.
Produce P1-V04-ARCHITECTURE implementation Evidence without adding future packages or production runtime semantics.

remediations.diagnosis: Two Windows clean authority rebuild attempts passed the quality baseline and then timed out in different existing Contract fixture tests during the second root test run; assertions, Linux, M0 and P1-V04 all passed.
remediations.change: Run the root Vitest suite with maxWorkers=1 so high-I/O fixture tests are scheduled deterministically without changing the 10 second timeout, assertions, coverage or the separate architecture suite.

remediations.diagnosis: Relative imports resolved across governed package roots were recorded as workspace edges but were not classified as deep imports, allowing a package to reach another package's internal source path.
remediations.change: Classify every resolved relative import that crosses governed package roots as DEEP_IMPORT while preserving public package-entry imports, direction, cycle and unresolved-import checks.

remediations.diagnosis: Package records were selected by manifest name, so a manifest at an existing governed root with an unexpected name could bypass that root's public-entry and workspace-dependency checks.
remediations.change: Select existing governed manifests by canonical root, reject a non-canonical manifest name, and continue evaluating public entries and workspace dependencies under the expected package policy.
remediations.executableRegression: Package-graph evaluation reports the name mismatch together with missing public entry, dependency inversion and non-canonical workspace range.

verification.check: operation-aware WRITE_SCOPE preflight and final scope

remainingGaps: The orchestrator must publish the remediated immutable head and record Linux, Windows and M0 workflow PASS.
P1-O03 requires independent verification and protected-main post-merge verification before any VERIFIED declaration.
